ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), Articles L.561-1 et seq. and R.561-1 et seq.; beneficial-owner identification principally under Articles L.561-2-2 and R.561-1; beneficial-owner filing obligations for legal entities under Article L.561-46 and related implementing provisions; company-register and filing rules under the French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), including Articles L.123-1 et seq. and R.123-46 et seq.; EU AML framework implemented through French law, including Directive (EU) 2015/849 as amended. The beneficial-owner register is maintained through the French register and one-stop filing system and is subject to restricted access following applicable EU and French legal developments.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Apply customer due diligence under Code monétaire et financier Articles L.561-4-1, L.561-5 et seq.; identify and risk-rate all direct and indirect beneficial owners, managers, signatories, intermediaries, banks, distributors, and key suppliers; conduct PEP and family/close-associate screening under Articles L.561-10 and R.561-18 et seq.; screen against UN Security Council lists, directly applicable EU restrictive-measures regulations, French national sanctions measures, and relevant domestic terrorism-financing lists. OFAC screening is not generally mandatory under French law but should be applied where a US nexus, US-dollar clearing, US person, or bank policy exists. Obtain source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence for enhanced-risk relationships. For heparin and animal-derived pharmaceutical inputs, screen suppliers, origin countries, customs parties, beneficial owners, export-control exposure, diversion risks, and sanctioned logistics routes. Retain records for the statutory AML period, generally five years after termination of the relationship or completion of the transaction, subject to applicable extensions.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by the Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI): https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; company-name and trademark searches should also be conducted through the Registre national des entreprises and INPI trademark databases.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be stated in the articles and filing in a form accepted by the French registry. French Latin script is ordinarily used; accented characters and standard French punctuation are generally accepted. A foreign-language or transliterated name may be used if not misleading, contrary to public order, confusingly similar to an existing protected name, or inconsistent with regulated-activity rules. A SARL must include the legal-form designation or its accepted abbreviation in official corporate documentation. Company-name clearance does not itself create trademark rights; separate French, EU, and international trademark searches are required.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque, bank, banking, établissement de crédit, or equivalent terms suggesting regulated banking activity
Assurance, insurance, réassurance, or equivalent terms suggesting regulated insurance activity
Mutuelle or terms reserved for regulated mutual entities
Bourse, marché financier, investment services, or equivalent regulated-finance terminology
Avocat, lawyer, notaire, huissier, expert-comptable, commissaire aux comptes, or other protected professional titles
Pharmacie, pharmacien, médicament, or equivalent pharmaceutical terms where the proposed activity or presentation could imply an unauthorized regulated establishment or activity
Governmental, ministerial, national, European, or public-authority designations that could create a false official affiliation
Terms that are discriminatory, contrary to public order, misleading as to legal form, activity, ownership, or regulatory authorization
Names confusingly similar to an existing registered company name, trade name, domain name, or protected trademark
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France has no general statutory 30-day company-name reservation certificate comparable to systems using a formal negative certificate. Conduct and document the name search before filing, including RNE, INPI trademark, EUIPO, domain, and trade-name checks. If the Guichet unique or registry rejects the proposed name, obtain the electronic rejection notice, identify whether the ground is similarity, protected terminology, public-order concern, or filing inconsistency, and correct the name or supporting evidence. Resubmit through the Guichet unique within the stated correction period. For an adverse formal registry decision, seek rectification before the competent registry or commercial court and, where legally available, challenge the decision under the applicable administrative or judicial procedure. Use a different compliant name immediately if incorporation timing is critical; do not rely on an informal reservation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A French SARL must have a registered office in France under the Commercial Code. Domiciliation with a licensed domiciliation provider may be permissible if the provider and contract comply with applicable Commercial Code requirements and the company can receive official correspondence and maintain required records. A virtual office is not an adequate substitute for operational premises for manufacture, extraction, storage, quality control, or release of heparin sodium or other active pharmaceutical substances. The proposed activity requires documented commercial substance, qualified personnel, validated premises, quality systems, traceability, supplier controls, and regulatory authorization or notification under the French Public Health Code and applicable EU pharmaceutical and animal-by-product rules.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated internal compliance risk: 20-40% likelihood of a physical or documentary inspection, audit, or site verification during the first 24 months for an active-pharmaceutical-substance operation, with materially higher likelihood following an authorization application, adverse inspection history, import alert, quality complaint, pharmacovigilance or product-safety concern, or animal-by-product compliance issue. This is a risk estimate, not an official French inspection statistic. ANSM, customs, local authorities, labor authorities, environmental authorities, and veterinary authorities may inspect within their respective mandates.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Code de commerce (Commercial Code): Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL formation, capital, and management), L.223-2 (no minimum share capital), R.223-1 to R.223-26 and R.123-1 et seq. (RCS registration formalities); Décret n°2021-1730 (Guichet Unique).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), maintained by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; filings centralized through the Guichet Unique, the official online portal (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Demande d'immatriculation (Formulaire Unique de transmission de données) together with the executed Statuts (Articles of Association) and the attestation of publication in a Journal d'Annonces Légales.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an SARL (Article L.223-2 of the Commercial Code); the Statuts may set the capital at any positive amount, commonly €1, and the entire cash contribution must be fully paid at subscription. Cash contributions are blocked in a dedicated account opened with a bank or with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations; the funds are released to the company only upon production of the RCS registration certificate (K-bis).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The shareholders (associés), upon incorporation of the SARL under the French Code de commerce, hereby: (1) acknowledge receipt of the Statuts and approve the corporate name; (2) ratify the subscription and full release of capital contributions by each founding associate; (3) adopt the registered office address and authorize its relocation by the Manager; (4) appoint the first Manager (Gérant) and determine powers and remuneration; (5) approve the corporate object expressly covering pharmaceutical fractionation of heparin; (6) authorize the opening of a bank account, filing before the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, and publication of the legal notice; (7) order the Manager to execute all formalities necessary for registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Statuts and Deposit of Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary (when the Statuts are drawn by acte notarié) or private deed with a certified accountant; capital blocked with a French credit institution or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalize the Articles of Association in French setting out the corporate form (SARL), share capital, precise corporate object (fractionation of low-molecular-weight heparin crude), and management provisions. Deposit the full cash contribution in a temporary blocked account opened in the name of the SARL en formation and obtain the attestation de dépôt des fonds (capital deposit certificate). If non-cash contributions are made, appoint a commissaire aux apports for valuation and attach the valuation report.
required_dossiers: Draft and executed copies of the Statuts
Identity documents (passport or national ID) of each associate and of the proposed Gérant
Capital deposit certificate or notarial attestation of funds
Valuation report of non-cash contributions (if any)
Evidence of registered-office availability (lease or domiciliation agreement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the deposit is refused for incomplete KYC, provide corrected originals or substitute the receiving institution; if the business-object clause is considered imprecise, amend the Statuts by an annex and have all associates countersign.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Legal Notice in a Journal d'Annonces Légales
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL) authorized in the department of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Transmit a notice to the JAL containing the corporate name, legal form (SARL), share capital amount, registered office address, corporate object, duration, and first manager's identity. Obtain the attestation de parution (proof of publication) to be enclosed with the registration dossier.
required_dossiers: Legal notice text (avis de constitution)
Corporate name and object wording
Identity details of the first Gérant
Registered office address details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL requires amendments to the notice, correct the text to align with the Statuts and republish; an amended notice must be issued within the legal publication window before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the Incorporation Dossier via the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) operated by INPI, transmitting automatically to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the single registration data-transmission form (Formulaire Unique) and upload the executed Statuts, capital deposit certificate, JAL publication proof, declarations of beneficial owners (bénéficiaires effectifs), identity and non-condemnation declarations of the legal representative, and registered-office occupancy proof. Pay the registration fee online; the dossier is then routed to the competent Greffe.
required_dossiers: Completed Formulaire Unique (M0 equivalent)
Executed Statuts signed by all associates
Attestation de dépôt des fonds or notarial certificate
Attestation de parution of the legal notice
Beneficial-owner declaration and consent of each beneficial owner
Identity and residence proof of the Gérant and associates
Registered-office occupancy document (lease, invoice, or letter of domiciliation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Guichet Unique raises an incompleteness query, file the missing document or corrected Statuts within the statutory cure period; failure to respond in 15 days invalidates the dossier and requires a fresh submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration and Issuance of the K-bis Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office's territorial department.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following compliance review, the Greffe assigns the RCS number and issues the Extrait K-bis, the conclusive proof of legal personality. The Guichet Unique automatically notifies INSEE (SIREN/SIRET attribution), the tax services (SIE) and URSSAF. Upon receipt of the K-bis, the capital-blocking institution releases the deposited funds to the company.
required_dossiers: Complete incorporation dossier as transmitted by the Guichet Unique
Payment confirmation of the registry fee
Original attestation de parution if requested by the registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe refuses registration for irregularities in the beneficial-owner declarations, correct the declarations and refile; a judicial order may be sought from the President of the Tribunal de Commerce to compel registration only where the dossier is otherwise complete and compliant.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Initial Corporate Governance Meeting and Manager's Acceptance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered office in France; minutes deposited in the corporate records (greffe if a modification is later needed).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene all founding associates to hold the initial general meeting; ratify the incorporation actions, approve the First Board Resolution, accept the Gérant's appointment, fix the registered office, and instruct the Gérant to execute the bank mandate, apply for the VAT and employer registrations, and file the corporate object with regulatory bodies for pharmaceutical activity. Record the resolution in an executed minutes register.
required_dossiers: Convocation notice or waiver of notice signed by all associates
Power of attorney for any represented associate
Written acceptance of the Gérant (and declaration of no legal incapacity)
Minutes of the initial meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the meeting cannot be convened unanimously, hold a first vote with statutory majorities and record the dissent; any governance amendment must be filed as a modification with the RCS within statutory delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Tax, Social, and Beneficial-Owner Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE), URSSAF, and the RCS repository of beneficial owners.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify the automatic attribution of SIREN/SIRET, intra-Community VAT number, and the employer registration dossier. Confirm the RBE declaration already transmitted to the RCS, register the Gérant for social security affiliation, deposit the opening bank mandate signature cards, and appoint a French certified accountant (expert-comptable) for statutory accounting and tax returns (formulaire 2042 and annual closure forms).
required_dossiers: Extrait K-bis
SIREN/SIRET notification from INSEE
VAT registration notification (if applicable)
Manager's social-security affiliation form
Bank account opening documents and specimen signatures
Executed First Board Resolution records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If no VAT or employer numbers are received within the automatic-exchange period, file a written request with the SIE and URSSAF attaching the K-bis; engage a chartered accountant to regularize any omitted declaration and, where needed, file a modification of registration for the regulated pharmaceutical activity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agence Nationale de Sécurité du Médicament et des Produits de Santé (ANSM) — Direction de l'Inspection des Etablissements pharmaceutiques; coordination with DREAL for classified installations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'ouverture d'établissement pharmaceutique for the manufacture, import and quality control of low-molecular-weight heparin crude and active substances of animal origin under Articles L.5136-1 and R.5136-14 of the Code de la santé publique (EU GMP equivalent licensing).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique et de la Cohésion des Territoires; DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) — Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE) prefectoral procedure
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: ICPE regime R.511-9 (Code de l'environnement) — Autorisation category (rubrique 3410 for pharmaceutical product preparation), requiring a formal environmental impact assessment (étude d'impact), public inquiry, and prefectoral operating authorization order.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits per the prefectoral operating order: pH 5.5-9.5, COD ≤ 125 mg/L daily average, BOD5 ≤ 25 mg/L, suspended solids ≤ 35 mg/L; ethanol-containing VOCs from heparin fractionation and solvent stripping must respect the French Arrete of 02/02/1998 (VOC fugitive threshold limits) and IED best available techniques; hazardous and animal-origin biological waste must be tracked with bordereaux de suivi des déchets and incinerated or decontaminated in authorized facilities.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance: favorable inspection notice from the departmental Commission de la Sécurité Contre l'Incendie et la Panique (CSICEP) for the industrial premises; structural integrity certificate issued by an approved Bureau de Contrôle covering column process loads and GMP clean-room floors; workplace clearance under the Code du travail (ventilation R.4222-1 et seq., electrical safety, and chemical agent risk prevention R.4412-1 et seq.) evidenced by a registre de sécurité.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) and the official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French entities register with INSEE to obtain SIREN and SIRET numbers; VAT identification (TVA intracommunautaire) is procured via DGFiP registration or automatic assignment upon incorporation; foreign entities must register for a French VAT number if establishing a fixed establishment or exceeding turnover thresholds in France
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box elections; hybrid mismatch and reverse hybrid rules under the Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive (ATAD) apply for certain structures

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: €35,000 in annual taxable supplies in France
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing for all B2B transactions since October 2024; real-time fiscal clearance via PEPES platform with digital time-stamping and API integration requirements for compliant taxpayers

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Eligibility for 0% VAT rate on exports of goods and services performed outside the EU; requires proof that goods are exported from the EU and not re-imported, along with compliance with customs and tax formalities
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en Douane d'Exportation - DAU)
Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of payment for offshore services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Administrative penalties of 80% of the erroneously claimed VAT for fraudulent zero-rating; full retrospective clawback of zero-rated VAT plus interest and potential criminal sanctions if export formalities are not met

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France operates as a full member of the Eurozone with unrestricted capital and current account convertibility under EU free movement rules and the French Monetary and Financial Code. Profit remittances to shareholders are permitted without restriction provided tax filings and AML reporting are satisfied. No capital controls apply to EU-resident entities; non-resident transactions require prior declaration for amounts exceeding €100,000.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds required in France. Export receipts must be declared to customs and tax authorities within 30 days of shipment. Conversion occurs at prevailing market rates; banks process via SWIFT with purpose codes. Statutory reporting thresholds apply for AML compliance.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Permitted under EU Electronic Money Institution regime supervised by Banque de France and EBA. Viability rating: Medium. Legal constraints include mandatory authorization, minimum capital of €350,000, strict AML/KYC obligations, and enhanced due diligence for pharmaceutical sectors.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote corporate onboarding fully permitted via digital KYC platforms and video verification. Physical appearance of directors required only for accounts exceeding €500,000 or specific high-risk triggers; otherwise remote opening authorized under French banking code.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Adverse media or sanctions screening on beneficial owners or directors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate ownership chart, source-of-funds statements, and beneficial ownership declarations

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pharmaceutical export license or GMP certification gaps
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid manufacturing authorization, CE marking, and export compliance certificates

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital via SWIFT MT103 or SEPA Instant in EUR. Mandatory purpose codes: 'CAP' for equity contributions, 'CON' for in-kind contributions. All wires require supporting documentation including shareholder resolutions and bank statements. Transactions above €10,000 subject to French TRACFIN reporting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements via SWIFT MT103 for wire transfers and Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP 600 for heparin exports. Use of confirmed LCs with tier-1 banks. All disbursements require export declaration and prior tax clearance from French customs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the end of the financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to €1,500 and potential administrative strike-off after 3 months of delinquency

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Update of Beneficial Owners Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually or within one month of any shareholding change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines and possible strike-off proceedings

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory statutory audit if annual turnover exceeds €800,000 or balance sheet total exceeds €400,000

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Beneficial owners declaration must be filed upon incorporation and updated annually or within one month of any shareholding transfers or control changes

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard Impôt sur les Sociétés (IS) for fiscal years opening on or after 1 January 2022 (Article 219 CGI); reduced 15% rate on the first €42,500 of taxable profit for qualifying SMEs (turnover ≤ €10 million)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Blended SME rate of approx. 15.2% where the €42,500 tranche applies; Research Tax Credit (CIR) equal to 30% of eligible R&D expenditure up to €100M (5% above); Innovation Tax Credit (CII) at 20% of eligible prototype expenses (capped); Patent Box (Article 238 CGI) reducing qualifying IP net income to a 40% taxable base (effective rate approx. 10% for a 25% headline); deferred taxation on internal capital gains; territorial exemption for qualifying participations.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward duration, but annual deduction is capped at €1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable income in excess of €1,000,000 (Article 209 CGI). Optional carry-back (report en arrière) of €1,000,000 to the preceding fiscal year. A 5-year rule is not applicable to French CIT.
